VASSAL.build.module.properties.ScenarioP.description: Set up at the start of a game. Define number of players & module features
VASSAL.build.module.properties.ScenarioP.heading:
Take note of the player side requirements relating to player count!! Solo and observers (if enabled) may access any side only if joined before the first Situation card is played or if no other non-observer sides are taken.
"Coalition" role uses the Russia hand.
Settings on this page may be amended only at the start of a turn, excepting the scenario itself (not changeable) and those marked with an asterisk (immediate effect).
VASSAL.build.module.properties.ScenarioP.name: Players & Module Features
VASSAL.build.module.properties.ScenarioP.report: {(GameStarted && propertyPrompt.startsWith("Scenario")) || propertyPrompt.startsWith("Number") || propertyPrompt.startsWith("Variant") || ((Phase > Initial || isCDGSM) && (propertyPrompt.startsWith("Open hands") || propertyPrompt.contains("as bot"))) ? "" : PlayerId + " " + mChanged + " " + propertyPrompt + " → " + newValue}

VASSAL.build.module.properties.ScenarioP.description: Set up at the start of a game or before a turn start
VASSAL.build.module.properties.ScenarioP.heading:
Congress of Vienna provides various ways to balance a game for bots and mixed player ability. For guidance, see PlayBook [20.13] & [21.12].
Settings on this page may be amended only at the start of a turn; the defaults provide for a standard game. New players may wish to set Initial Situation card play to "historical" but are otherwise recommended to run with defaults.

Handicap cards: set to "Manual" if you wish to vary Handicap card draws throughout a game. Otherwise the quantities below are dealt at the "Deal Handicap Cards" step. For mixed sides, only the "Russian" cards are dealt.
VASSAL.build.module.properties.ScenarioP.name: Play Balance

AB  Flip up cards A and B.

ABC Flip up cards A, B and the top card in C.

C< Flip top card C.

CDE Flip up cards D, E and the top card in C.

DE  Flip up cards D and E.
